source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 4.1 states consistency, asymptotic normality, and attainment of the semiparametric efficiency bound by the proposed staggered-DiD estimator; its displayed expansion uses the previously derived optimal conditional weighting formula.

The article develops Lasso and post-Lasso first-stage predictions and optimal instruments for linear instrumental-variables models, with sparse-model rate conditions; it does not establish a generic cross-fitted L4 rate for a conditional covariance-derived Moore--Penrose loading.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define bOVS on singular blocks using the same Moore--Penrose plus minimum-norm convention as bconst, or explicitly impose the required block nonsingularity in every theorem that invokes it.

Replace ass:loading-rate by a perturbation lemma deriving an L2/L4 loading bound from Gammahat, the fixed-rank projector, and the spectral gap; retain only any genuinely additional moment condition needed for L4 control.
Correct the ChenSantAnnaXie2025 comparison anchor to its EIF/bound theorem and state explicitly which DDD full-data-extension or tangent step has no DiD analogue.
Add a finite-dimensional implementation corollary for the equality diagnostic, including the covariance-block convention and a testable plug-in projection residual.

recommended_next_step: Revise the comparator anchor and make both published comparator loadings globally defined; then derive rather than assume the learned-loading rate before advancing the field-tier DDD efficiency kernel to Stage 0.
